name: M3_DPS001MI_LstRelation
description:
List warehouse distribution relations for a given relation type. Each relation connects a from-warehouse with a to-warehouse and a delivery method, and includes transportation days and hours that influence lead-time and available-date calculations at the receiving warehouse.

Relation type defines how the relation is maintained:

- **1 – Warehouse to warehouse:** Direct distribution between two warehouses; transport time and distribution calendar are maintained per warehouse pair, without item-specific identities.
- **2 – Distribution group based:** Relation is maintained per distribution group, defined per item and warehouse, typically for items with multiple supply alternatives.
- **3 – Item/warehouse exception:** Distribution exception per item and warehouse, also only for items with multiple supply alternatives.

inputParameters.name: RLTY
inputParameters.description: Relation type that determines how warehouse distribution is controlled and which relations to list.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company number used to restrict the listed distribution relations to a specific company.

inputParameters.name: FWLO
inputParameters.description: From warehouse used to filter distribution relations where this warehouse supplies goods.

inputParameters.name: TWLO
inputParameters.description: To warehouse used to filter distribution relations where this warehouse receives goods.

inputParameters.name: WHGR
inputParameters.description: Warehouse group used to filter distribution relations maintained for that group.

outputParameters.name: CONO
outputParameters.description: Company number for the distribution relation.

outputParameters.name: RLTY
outputParameters.description: Relation type defining whether the distribution is maintained by warehouse-to-warehouse link, warehouse group, or item and warehouse.

outputParameters.name: FWLO
outputParameters.description: Warehouse from which goods are distributed in this relation.

outputParameters.name: TWLO
outputParameters.description: Warehouse to which goods are distributed in this relation.

outputParameters.name: MODL
outputParameters.description: Delivery method used for transportation between the warehouses in this relation.

outputParameters.name: TRDY
outputParameters.description: Number of workdays expected to transport goods between the warehouses in this relation.

outputParameters.name: TRTE
outputParameters.description: Number of hours expected to transport goods between the warehouses in this relation.
